# TOOOLS.design

> > A comprehensive directory of 2000+ design resources and tools curated to help designers level up their creative toolkit across disciplines.

TOOOLS.design is a curated platform that aggregates design tools, resources, and learning materials for designers at all levels. The site covers everything from design software and AI tools to inspiration galleries, icon libraries, and community spaces, making it a one-stop reference for building an optimized design toolkit.

## Key Topics

- Design Tools
- AI Design Tools
- Figma
- Framer
- UI/UX Design
- Design Resources
- Adobe Suite
- Webflow
- Icon Libraries
- Design Inspiration
- Stock Media
- Typography
- Color Tools
- Design Communities
- Productivity Tools

## Core Design Tools & Software

- [Best Design Tools Across Disciplines](https://www.toools.design/best-design-tools): Overview of design tools including Figma, Framer, Sketch, and Penpot.
- [Best AI Design Tools for Designers](https://www.toools.design/ai-design-tools): Curated AI design tools including Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, and Google Gemini.
- [Best UX Tools for Designers](https://www.toools.design/best-ux-tools): UX tools for research, wireframing, prototyping including Dovetail and UXtweak.
- [Productivity Tools for Design and Product Teams](https://www.toools.design/productivity-tools-for-design-and-poduct-teams): Productivity tools for teams including Figma, FigJam, Notion, and Miro.
- [Marketing Tools for Designers & Creative Teams](https://www.toools.design/marketing-tools): Marketing and social media design tools including Canva and Adobe Express.

## Design Assets & Resources

- [Free Stock Images & Video Websites](https://www.toools.design/free-stock-images-videos): Stock photo and video resources including Unsplash, Pixabay, and Freepik.
- [Best Free Open Source Icon Libraries](https://www.toools.design/free-open-source-icon-libraries): Open source icon libraries including Material Symbols, Heroicons, and Lucide.
- [Best Open Source Illustration Libraries](https://www.toools.design/free-open-source-illustrations): Free illustration libraries featuring unDraw, Storyset, and MixKit Art.
- [Best Sites for Mockups, Freebies, UI Kits](https://www.toools.design/mockups-ui-kits-and-freebies): Curated mockup and UI kit platforms including Mockuuups and Rotato.
- [Best Free Font Libraries and Inspiration for Designers](https://www.toools.design/font-library-and-inspiration): Font libraries and typography resources including Typewolf and type.lol.
- [Best Color Tools and Inspiration for Designers](https://www.toools.design/best-color-inspiration-tools): Color tools and palettes including Color Hunt, Picular, and Color Leap.

## Design Inspiration & Learning

- [Design Inspiration Sites for UI, Web, Graphic & Branding](https://www.toools.design/ui-web-design-inspiration-websites): Design inspiration resources featuring Mobbin, Behance, and Dribbble.
- [Learn UI/UX Design: Courses, Guides & Best Practices](https://www.toools.design/learn-ui-ux-design): UI/UX courses and guides from IDF, Uxcel, Coursera, and Designlab.
- [Best Design Blogs & Magazines for Designers](https://www.toools.design/best-design-blogs-and-magazines): Design publications including Design Observer, Dezeen, and AIGA Eye on Design.
- [Best Design Podcasts for Designers](https://www.toools.design/best-design-podcasts): Design podcast recommendations including Design Matters and The Futur.
- [The Best Books for Designers – Essential Reads](https://www.toools.design/books-for-designers): Curated design book recommendations on branding, UX, and generative AI.

## Community & Networking

- [Best Design Communities for Designers](https://www.toools.design/design-communities): Design communities directory including Slack groups and networking platforms.

## Deals & Directory

- [Design Resources & Tools for Designers](https://www.toools.design): Directory of 2000+ design resources and tools including Streamline, Flowstep, Kittl, Holo.
- [TOOOLS.design Deals – Handpicked Discounts & Coupon Codes](https://www.toools.design/deals): Curated discounts and coupon codes for design tools like Framer Pro and Uxcel Pro.

## Blog & Updates

- [TOOOLS.design Blog – Level Up Your Design Tool Stack](https://www.toools.design/blog): Blog covering design tools, trends, AI tools, and Figma/Webflow resources for designers.
